subject: blocking client followup fix related to log_req_res (#1989)
reason: The change only relocates the reqresSaveClientReplyOffset call inside _addReplyToBufferOrList so the request/response-log offset is saved before replies are diverted to the deferred-reply or pending-push lists. That function is compiled only under the LOG_REQ_RES debug build flag; in standard builds (what the fuzzer runner compiles) it is an empty inline stub, so both builds behave identically. Even on a LOG_REQ_RES build the fix affects only the contents of the hidden req-res-logfile used by Valkey's reply-schema CI, not any reply, data, replication or persistence behavior, so no fuzzer oracl
